Package org.apache.beam.sdk.io.splunk

Class SplunkEvent

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.sdk.io.splunk.SplunkEvent
@DefaultCoder(SplunkEventCoder.class) public abstract class SplunkEvent extends Object
A SplunkEvent describes a single payload sent to Splunk's Http Event Collector (HEC) endpoint.

Each object represents a single event and related metadata elements such as:

  • time
  • host
  • source
  • sourceType
  • index
